summary: Deflate compression loop structurally twin to 005365D0, with extra match-quality heuristics and deferred-literal handling. Refills input via TextBufferDecompressor below 262 available bytes, inserts bytes into a hash chain, calls ZlibDeflateLongestMatch for LZ77 matching, and rejects short/expensive matches (length <= 5 with distance > 0x1000) in favour of literals. A pending-literal flag at a1+94 defers one byte across the loop, and HuffmanBitStreamEncoder plus BufferCopyWithSizeTracking flush output when the pending buffer reaches its limit.

local_names.a2: flush flag (equal to 4 for end-of-block marker)
local_names.v11: candidate match length from longest-match search
local_names.v12: previous match length saved at a1+110

operations.description: Outer while(1) loop processes one symbol (literal or length/distance pair) per iteration; exits on exhausted input or a flush/buffer-full return.

When the available byte count at a1+106 drops below 262, call TextBufferDecompressor(a1) to refill; if still below 262 with no flush (a2 == 0) return 0 for more input, and break when the count reaches zero.

When the count is at least 3, compute the hash key v8 = state at a1+74 AND (input byte at a1+46 + pos + 2 XOR (previous hash at a1+62 shifted left by a1+78)) for hash-chain insertion, then store the chain entry and update the hash state.
Save the prior match length to a1+110 and the prior distance to a1+90, then default the match length at a1+86 to 2 before attempting the longest-match search.
If a chain entry v4 exists, the position is within the window (pos - v4 <= a1+34 - 262), and the mode at a1+126 is not 2, call ZlibDeflateLongestMatch(a1, v4).
Reject a short match: when the match length is at most 5 and (mode at a1+126 equals 1 or length equals 3 with distance > 0x1000), force a1+86 to 2 so the literal path is taken.

Literal path when the previous match length a1+110 is below 3 or a1+86 exceeds it: if the pending-literal flag at a1+94 is set, emit the deferred byte and bump its frequency counter, flushing when the pending buffer reaches its limit; otherwise set a1+94 to 1 to defer the current byte.
Buffer full during a literal emit: flush HuffmanBitStreamEncoder(count, 0) and drain the output stream with BufferCopyWithSizeTracking; return 0 if the stream reports full.

Match path: emit a length/distance pair (distance = pos minus a1+90 minus 1, length byte = match_len - 3) and update the length/distance frequency tables using byte_5B84F8, byte_5B83F8 and byte_5B82F8.
Inner do-while loop advances hash-chain insertion per consumed byte while the remaining match length at a1+110 is decremented toward zero, then resets the pending-literal flag a1+94 to 0.
When the pending buffer reaches its limit after a match, flush HuffmanBitStreamEncoder(pending count, 0) and drain the output stream with BufferCopyWithSizeTracking; return 0 if the stream is full.
Loop-exit finalization: emit any remaining pending literal, then perform the final flush HuffmanBitStreamEncoder(pending count, a2 == 4) and drain with BufferCopyWithSizeTracking.
Return code from the set 0, 1, 2, 3 encoding flush status: 0 when more input is needed or the output stream is full, otherwise 1 + 2*(a2 == 4) when the stream is still writable.
